title: Buss her, wap in rogues’ rum lingo, for, O, my dimber wapping dell! A shefiend’s whiteness under her rancid rags. Fumbally’s lane that night: the tanyard smells.
html_source:
Some definitions:

Buss = kiss

Wap = make love

Dimber wapping dell = a female who enjoys these acts.

Stephen is again imagining a story for this pair. He sees the female as a prostitute and the male as her “pimp”.

anchor.prefix: e. When night hides her body's flaws calling under her brown shawl from an archway where dogs have mired. Her fancyman is treating two Royal Dublins in O'Loughlin's of Blackpitts.
anchor.suffix:
White thy fambles, red thy gan 
And thy quarrons dainty is. 
Couch a hogshead with me then. 
In the darkmans clip and kiss.
